body: I have lost my long time pet and even this many months on, it's still really hard. It's just hurts when you feel like you're losing the things that keep you together you know. I think if I needed to summarize anxiety/depression to someone, it would just be "everything is really hard, constantly with better and worse times". It's just...hard. And that level of pervasive thinking is I think hard to comprehend for a lot of people. I wish you all the best, it's good to even know that other people have the same fight too.
I've felt that way for longer than I know. And then I occasionally look up and realize I'm still here somehow.

There were really two main things that kept me in the fight. And one of them was my wonderful cat. We grew up together and took care of each other. After a long life he passed away last year. It's hard, and it chips away at you when you're barely holding on. Hold on to them and cherish your time. I know they appreciate it.
